en: Sepia-toned historic photograph of a Middle Eastern street scene dominated by an ornate mosque with a large patterned dome and a highly decorated minaret. The building shows alternating light and dark stone courses and arched windows. In the background there is another slender striped minaret. People in traditional long garments walk along an unpaved street lined with older buildings. At the bottom center, a small printed website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears, likely added by the archive and not original to the postcard.
